title: NCAA: Torculas shines as San Beda survives JRU's fightback
summary: San Beda kept its composure in holding on for a 75-71 win over Jose Rizal University in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament, Friday at the FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan.
